fields.statement: QA at 59869bfc with a scratch build (go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-x) in a fresh git repo, fake rex on PATH: hook ls printed 'notify: unset' / 'event: unset' and --json source unset; after git config rhiza.notifyCommand it showed '(git config)'; with a live 'rhiza daemon --permission-mode manual --notify-command "echo flag-notify"' and rhiza.eventCommand in config it showed 'notify: echo flag-notify (daemon flag)' and 'event: echo cfg-ev (git config)', and kept the daemon's value after git config changed under it; daemon status showed 'Hook notify: ...' lines and --json hooks with name/command/source; after SIGINT stop hook ls fell back to git config. go test hook-commands and describe-golden passed; make check exited 0.

QA at 59869bfc with a scratch build in a fresh repo: hook run notify (git config command) got the sample inbox JSON on stdin and RHIZA_INBOX_KIND/ID/CHANGE/TITLE in env, printed its stdout and stderr then 'notify hook: exit status 0', exit 0; hook run event --command got the lifecycle JSON and RHIZA_EVENT=accepted; 'echo boom; exit 7' printed boom and exited 7 (--json code 7); unset event hook and unknown hook both exited 2 with next hints; api call hook.run gave the same response; with a live daemon, hook run notify used the daemon flag command and daemon.state.json was unchanged before and after.
